method: Original generated editorial still lifes with the built-in OpenAI ImageGen tool. No source images were supplied. WebP derivatives use Lanczos resizing without retouching.
placement: Catalogue and editorial context on Hyrule Atlas. Illustrations of general unbranded tools, not game footage.
